name: holm teaching kitchen v2 interior
review_note: With the roof off the bakehouse reads as a second occupation cluster: herb and onion strings from the beams, loaves on the bread rack, flour dust on the kneading table, a bread peel at the range; the range flame and the pantry line (bin, trough, butt, buckets) keep the bake lesson readable left to right.
verdict: meets the 9.0 gate - owner eyes-on still required
improve: The pantry corner is still bare wall above the buckets; the strings are small at the elevated camera.
